---
title: "Phage bacteria ratios"
output: html_document
date: "2025-11-06"
---

```{r}
## ---- Load the following libraries ----------------------
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(stringr)
library(scales)
library(ggpattern)
library(here)   # <<--- añadido

## ---- Inputs --------------------------------------------
bact_xlsx <- here("data", "mmc3.xlsx")
phage_csv <- here("data", "FINAL_data_forplots_CPMs_RPMs_newmetadata.csv")

## ---- Output directory ----------------------------------
out_dir <- here("results", "figures", "phage_bacteria_ratio")
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# ---- Palette of colors ----------------------------------
custom_colors <- c(
  "Streptococcus"    = "pink",
  "Bacteroides"      = "mediumaquamarine",
  "Escherichia"      = "gold",
  "Faecalibacterium" = "#C499CC",
  "Bifidobacterium"  = "#6FA3F7",
  "Klebsiella"       = "#7B2CBF",
  "Blautia"          = "#90DDF0",
  "Gemmiger"         = "#FFAC81",
  "Ruminococcus"     = "#FA6459",
  "Pseudomonas"      = "#EEE2DF"
)

## ---- Load data from bacteria ----------------------------
bact_raw <- read_excel(bact_xlsx)
stopifnot("clade_name" %in% names(bact_raw))

bact_num <- bact_raw %>%
  mutate(across(-clade_name, ~ as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", as.character(.))))) 

bact_long <- bact_num %>%
  pivot_longer(-clade_name, names_to = "Sample", values_to = "percent") %>%
  mutate(prop = percent / 100)

extract_genus_tax <- function(x){
  ifelse(str_detect(x, "g__"), str_replace(x, ".*g__", ""), NA_character_)
}

bact_genus <- bact_long %>%
  mutate(Genus = extract_genus_tax(clade_name)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Genus)) %>%
  group_by(Sample, Genus) %>%
  summarise(Rel_abund_bact = sum(prop, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

## ---- Load data from phages ----------------------------
phage_df <- read.csv(phage_csv, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

meta <- phage_df %>%
  select(Sample, mother_infant, bodysite) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(Host = case_when(
    mother_infant == "infant" ~ "Infant",
    mother_infant == "mother" ~ "Mother",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  ))

extract_host_genus <- function(x){
  ifelse(!is.na(x) & str_detect(x, "g__"), str_replace(x, ".*g__", ""), NA_character_)
}

phage_genus <- phage_df %>%
  mutate(Genus = extract_host_genus(Host.genus)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Genus)) %>%
  group_by(Sample, Genus) %>%
  summarise(CPM_genus = sum(CPM, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Sample) %>%
  mutate(CPM_total = sum(CPM_genus, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(Rel_abund_phage = if_else(CPM_total > 0, CPM_genus / CPM_total, 0))

## ---- Join bacteria and phage data (only stool) --------
df_scatter <- bact_genus %>%
  inner_join(phage_genus, by = c("Sample","Genus")) %>%
  inner_join(meta, by = "Sample") %>%
  filter(bodysite == "stool", !is.na(Host)) %>%
  mutate(Host = factor(Host, levels = c("Infant","Mother")))

## ---- Mean of relative abundances and ratio ------------
df_summary <- df_scatter %>%
  group_by(Host, Genus) %>%
  summarise(
    Rel_abund_bact  = mean(Rel_abund_bact,  na.rm = TRUE),
    Rel_abund_phage = mean(Rel_abund_phage, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

eps <- 1e-6
df_ratios <- df_summary %>%
  mutate(
    Genus_plot = Genus,
    ratio      = Rel_abund_phage / (Rel_abund_bact + eps)
  )

# ---- log10 axis (to avoid seq.default error) -----------
vals <- df_ratios$ratio[is.finite(df_ratios$ratio) & df_ratios$ratio > 0]
if (length(vals) == 0) stop("No positive ratios to plot.")
minp <- min(vals); maxp <- max(vals)
if (minp == maxp) { minp <- minp / 3; maxp <- maxp * 3 }
lb <- floor(log10(minp)); ub <- ceiling(log10(maxp))
brks <- 10^(lb:ub)

# ---- FINAL PLOT (mothers with stripes) -----------------
p_ratio <- ggplot(df_ratios,
  aes(x = Genus_plot, y = ratio, fill = Genus_plot, pattern = Host)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40") +
  ggpattern::geom_col_pattern(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), width = 0.7,
    colour = "black", linewidth = 0.25,
    pattern_fill = "black", pattern_density = 0.5,
    pattern_spacing = 0.06, pattern_key_scale_factor = 1.6
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    trans = "log10",
    limits = c(minp, maxp),
    breaks = brks,
    minor_breaks = NULL,
    labels = label_number(accuracy = 0.1),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.08))
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = custom_colors, drop = FALSE,
    guide = guide_legend(title = "Genus",
      override.aes = list(pattern = "none", colour = NA))
  ) +
  scale_pattern_manual(
    values = c(Infant = "none", Mother = "stripe"),
    guide = guide_legend(title = "Host")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Phage-to-bacteria ratio per genus (stool)",
    x = "Host genus",
    y = "Phage/Bacteria ratio (log scale)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x      = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.key.width = grid::unit(1, "cm"),
    legend.key.height= grid::unit(0.7, "cm")
  )

print(p_ratio)

## ---- Save plots ----------------------------------------
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "phage_bacteria_ratio_stool.png"),
       plot = p_ratio, width = 11, height = 7, units = "in",
       dpi = 600, bg = "white")

ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "phage_bacteria_ratio_stool.pdf"),
       plot = p_ratio, width = 11, height = 7, units = "in",
       bg = "white")

```
